description: Bank loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC/ST or women to start a first-time non-farm enterprise (greenfield project).
Eligible: SC/ST or women entrepreneurs, age 18+, first-time enterprise in manufacturing/services/trading.
At least 51% ownership must be held by SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.
Applicant should not be in default to any bank/financial institution.
documents_required: Detailed project report for greenfield enterprise
Financial projections and margin contribution proof
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore per eligible borrower

description: Collateral-free loans for micro-enterprises in four categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001–₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5–10 lakh), Tarun Plus (₹10–20 lakh).
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–65, with non-farm income-generating activities (manufacturing, trading, services, allied agriculture).
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC entrepreneurs.
No minimum income ceiling; clean credit history preferred.
documents_required: Identity proof (any one: Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, Driving License, Passport)
Business proof (Udyam registration, GST, trade license, or Shop & Establishment certificate)
Bank account details with 6 months statement
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹20 lakh per borrower (Tarun Plus category)

description: Government subsidy (15–35%) for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing or services.
Eligible: Any Indian citizen above 18 years; no income ceiling.
Project cost limit: ₹50 lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 lakh for services.
Higher subsidy for SC/ST/OBC, women, and rural applicants.
Applicant should contribute 5–10% own margin money.
documents_required: Educational certificates (where applicable, minimum 8th pass for projects above ₹10 lakh)
Caste/category certificate (if applicable for higher subsidy)
Proof of own margin money contribution
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹20 lakh (services) with 15–35% subsidy

description: Scholarship for SC students studying after Class 10 (Class 11/12, diploma, graduation, PG, PhD, etc.).
Covers tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowance.
Eligible: SC students, family income usually below ₹2.5 lakh per year.
Must be studying in recognised institutions.
documents_required: Current year admission proof and fee receipt
channel_partner_name: District Social Welfare Office + CSC centre
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: Full tuition/exam fees + maintenance allowance (varies by course, typically ₹10,000–₹60,000 per year)

description: Savings scheme for girl child's future education and marriage expenses.
Government-backed account with attractive interest rate (compounded annually).
Eligible: Girl child below 10 years (relaxation up to 12 years in some cases).
One account per girl child; minimum deposit required annually to keep account active.
documents_required: Birth certificate of the girl child
Aadhaar card of girl child (if available) and parent/guardian
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: Government-backed savings account with notified interest rate (currently ~8.2% p.a., compounded annually)

scheme_name: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act)
description: Guarantees at least 100 days of wage employment per financial year to adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
Wages paid directly into bank or post office accounts.
Eligible: Adult members (18+) of rural households across India.
No caste, gender, or income bar; open to all rural families.
Employment is demand-based: household must apply for work when needed.
documents_required: Aadhaar card of all adult members
Ration card or other identity proof
Bank or post office account details for wage payment
Job card application form (available at Gram Panchayat)
Proof of residence in the Gram Panchayat area
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office, Village – Rampur, District – Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: At least 100 days of wage employment per household per year (wage rate varies by state, typically ₹200–₹300 per day)

scheme_name: Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
description: Merit-based scholarship for students who scored 80th percentile or above in Class 12 board exams.
Provides ₹12,000 per year for undergraduate studies and ₹20,000 per year for postgraduate studies.
Eligible: Indian citizens, family income below ₹8 lakh per year, studying in recognised institutions.
No caste restriction; merit-based.
documents_required: Current course admission/enrollment proof with AISHE code
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: ₹12,000 per year (UG) or ₹20,000 per year (PG) for duration of course

scheme_name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
description: Scholarship for SC students pursuing top-class education in recognised institutions (engineering, medicine, law, etc.).
Covers tuition fees, maintenance allowance, books, and other expenses.
Eligible: SC students, family income below ₹8 lakh per year, admitted to top institutions.
Merit-based selection.
channel_partner_name: District Social Welfare Office + NSP portal
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: Full tuition fees + maintenance allowance (up to ₹3–4 lakh per year depending on course)

description: Pension scheme for unorganised sector workers, guaranteeing fixed monthly pension after age 60.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–40 years, with bank account.

Subscribers contribute monthly until age 60; government co-contributes 50% of subscriber's contribution (up to ₹1,000 per year) for 5 years for eligible subscribers (non-income taxpayers, not covered by statutory social security).
Guaranteed minimum pension: ₹1,000/₹2,000/₹3,000/₹4,000/₹5,000 per month, depending on contribution.
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60, depending on contribution

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance scheme with ₹2 lakh cover for death due to any cause.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–50 years, with bank account.
Annual premium: ₹436 (auto-debited from bank account).
Coverage continues till age 55 with annual renewal.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover

description: Accident insurance scheme with ₹2 lakh cover for accidental death or permanent disability, ₹1 lakh for partial disability.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–70 years, with bank account.
Annual premium: ₹20 (auto-debited from bank account).
Coverage continues till age 70 with annual renewal.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹2 lakh for accidental death/permanent disability, ₹1 lakh for partial disability

description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses in rural areas.
Eligible: Rural households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses, prioritised for SC/ST, minorities, women-headed households.
Benefit: ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) in instalments.
Selection based on Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data.
documents_required: BPL ration card or SECC-listed proof
Filled application form at Gram Panchayat
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office, Village – Khajuraho, District – Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for house construction

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
description: Organises rural poor into Self-Help Groups (SHGs) for sustainable livelihoods and access to credit.
Eligible: Rural poor households, priority to SC/ST, minorities, women.
Provides capacity building, financial inclusion, and enterprise promotion support.
SHGs can access bank loans with government support.
documents_required: Aadhaar card of all SHG members
BPL ration card or poverty proof
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Access to bank loans (typically ₹10–15 lakh per SHG) with government support and interest subvention

description: Supports SC/ST entrepreneurs in accessing government procurement opportunities.
Provides handholding, capacity building, and market linkage support.
Eligible: SC/ST-owned enterprises registered as MSMEs.
Helps in bidding for government tenders and corporate supply chains.
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: Support for accessing government procurement (tenders worth crores), capacity building, and market linkages

description: Micro-finance scheme for SC women for income-generating activities.
Eligible: SC women, family income below ₹3 lakh per year.
Loan amount up to ₹50,000 at concessional interest rate.
Implemented through State Channelizing Agencies and banks.
documents_required: Basic project details for income-generating activity
channel_partner_name: Uttar Pradesh State SC Development Corporation + State Bank of India
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹50,000 micro-finance loan at concessional interest

description: Term loan for SC entrepreneurs for setting up or expanding income-generating activities.
Eligible: SC individuals, family income below ₹3 lakh per year (rural/urban).
Loan amount up to ₹15 lakh at concessional interest rate.
Repayment period up to 7 years with moratorium.
channel_partner_name: Tamil Nadu Adi Dravidar Housing and Development Corporation + Indian Bank
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹15 lakh term loan at concessional interest

description: Loan for Self-Help Groups (SHGs) of OBC/Backward Classes members.
Eligible: SHGs with majority OBC/BC members, family income below ₹3 lakh per year.
Loan amount up to ₹10 lakh per SHG at concessional interest.
Implemented through State Channelizing Agencies and banks.
documents_required: Aadhaar cards of all SHG members
Basic project details for group activity
channel_partner_name: Karnataka State BC Corporation + Canara Bank
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh per SHG at concessional interest

description: Concessional loan for SC Safai Karamcharis, manual scavengers, and their dependents for self-employment.
Eligible: SC Safai Karamcharis/manual scavengers or dependents, family income below ₹3 lakh per year.
Loan amount varies by activity (micro-finance to term loans).
Implemented through State Channelizing Agencies and banks.
documents_required: Safai Karamchari/manual scavenger certificate or dependent proof
channel_partner_name: Rajasthan State SC and ST Corporation + Punjab National Bank
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Varies by activity: micro-finance up to ₹50,000, term loans up to ₹10–15 lakh

scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana
description: State scheme providing loan and subsidy for youth to start new enterprises.
Eligible: UP residents, age 21–45 years, family income below ₹2 lakh per year.
Loan up to ₹10 lakh with 25% subsidy (30% for SC/ST).
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC youth.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh loan with 25–30% subsidy

scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Mahila Udyam Nidhi Yojana
description: State scheme providing concessional loans to women entrepreneurs.
Eligible: Women residents of UP, age 21–55 years, family income below ₹5–7.5 lakh.
Loan up to ₹10 lakh at 4% interest rate.
Priority to SC/ST/OBC women.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh loan at 4% interest

description: State scheme providing financial assistance to entrepreneurs from EBC, BC, and minority communities.
Eligible: Bihar residents, age 18–50 years, from EBC/BC/minority categories.
Financial assistance up to ₹10 lakh (₹5 lakh for general category within EBC/BC).
Implemented through banks with government support.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh financial assistance

scheme_name: Madhya Pradesh Savitri Bai Phule Swa-Sahayata Samuh Yojana
description: State scheme supporting SC women's self-help groups for self-employment.
Eligible: SC women residents of MP, age 18–60 years.
Provides margin money up to ₹15,000 for self-employment projects up to ₹50,000.
Implemented through banks and district authorities.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Margin money up to ₹15,000 for projects up to ₹50,000

description: State scheme providing concessional bank loans and subsidy to women entrepreneurs.
Eligible: Women residents of Tamil Nadu, age 21–55 years, family income below ₹5–7.5 lakh.
Priority to SC/ST/OBC women.
Loan with interest subvention/subsidy for setting up small businesses.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Typically up to ₹5–10 lakh loan with interest subvention/subsidy

description: State scheme supporting startups with funding, mentorship, and infrastructure.
Eligible: Kerala-based startups in innovation/technology sectors.
Provides equity funding, grants, and incubation support.
Priority to women, SC/ST entrepreneurs.
documents_required: Startup registration with Kerala Startup Mission
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: Equity funding up to ₹50 lakh, plus grants and incubation support

scheme_name: Telangana TS-iPASS (Telangana State Industrial Project Approval and Self-Certification System)
description: State scheme facilitating easy approvals and incentives for industrial projects.
Eligible: Entrepreneurs setting up manufacturing/service units in Telangana.
Provides capital subsidy, power tariff reimbursement, and other incentives.
Priority to MSMEs, women, SC/ST entrepreneurs.
channel_partner_name: Telangana State Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (TSIIC) Office, Hyderabad
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: Capital subsidy up to 25% of investment, power tariff reimbursement, and other incentives
